recap: Goal: the Future War look of The Terminator (1984). Compare the original game, selected V2 references and actual Mac progress below.
Kite3D 0.19.0-alpha.2 reduces repeated transforms and two redundant render passes. V2 lighting, smoke, geometry and gameplay remain; enemy overlays stay removed.
Mac M3 Max: 90.9 FPS in 60 seconds of moving combat, at the High preset’s actual 1512×982 buffer. CPU p95 was 13.7 ms; this is not physical Retina resolution.
Targets remain 75 FPS / 13.33 ms and under 10 seconds to gameplay. Latest cold startup: 14.96 seconds. Final acceptance is pending; art refinement is deferred to issue #2.
source_note: User-message excerpts verified against the original session record. UTC timestamps and line references are retained; the private transcript and attachment paths are not included. Original spelling and casing are preserved.

performance_notes: Provisional 650s timing: possible interference from accidentally auto-opened peer tabs was discovered after collection. No Linux performance acceptance or clean comparative speedup is claimed. 650s Linux, NVIDIA RTX 3090 Ti, 1920×1080: engine-only populated combat 24.5 FPS; final dynamic-light frame candidate 30.0 FPS, CPU median/p95 12.9/15.3 ms. A separate 60-second moving route covered 299 metres with 24 actors at 29.2 FPS. These are not Mac acceptance numbers.

Apple M3 Max: combined-build measurements varied from 31.9 to 74.3 FPS in headless moving runs. The later normal headed 120 Hz-display run reached 90.9 FPS over 60 seconds with 24 actors and 299 metres of movement; CPU median/p95 10.3/13.7 ms. High actually rendered 1512×982 pixels, not the display’s physical 3024×1964 pixels. Final-build repeat and frame-tail margin remain to verify.

Targets remain sustained 75 FPS (13.33 ms frame budget) and under 10 seconds from editor Play to responsive gameplay. Actual immediate-transition startup remains over budget: the latest unprofiled Mac combined measurement was 14.96 seconds. Startup profiling and image-upload work continue; no synthetic three-second menu wait is included in this acceptance total.

This is an intermediate performance milestone, not final acceptance. The five progress images show the combined dynamic-light source on Mac; fixed images, populated timings and startup measurements are labeled separately. Art and smoke refinement remain deferred to issue #2. Original visual targets and all 17 earlier milestones are retained.
